name: Got it
when: Acknowledging an instruction or a correction

variants.name: Nod
variants.desc: Two quick nods with happy eyes.

variants.name: Tick
variants.desc: A green tick draws itself and it hops.

variants.name: Ding
variants.desc: A bright little burst and a bounce.

variants.name: Noted
variants.desc: Ticks items off on a notepad, then nods.

variants.name: Light bulb
variants.desc: A light bulb switches on above its head.

parts.t: <g class="cheeks"><ellipse cx="{{a.ck1}}" cy="{{a.cky}}" rx="6" ry="3.4"></ellipse><ellipse cx="{{a.ck2}}" cy="{{a.cky}}" rx="6" ry="3.4"></ellipse></g>

<g class="eg eg-n" stroke="{{a.eye}}"><g transform="translate({{a.lex}} {{a.ley}})"><path class="gl" d="M-5 2Q0 -4 5 2"></path></g><g transform="translate({{a.rex}} {{a.rey}})"><path class="gl" d="M-5 2Q0 -4 5 2"></path></g></g>
<g class="fx-tick" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g transform="translate(84 12)"><circle class="a tkc okf" cx="0" cy="0" r="8.5"></circle><path class="tkm" d="M-4 0L-1 3L4.5 -3.5"></path></g></g>

<g class="fx-notepad" transform="translate(0 {{a.dn}})"><g transform="translate(50 78)"><rect class="pw" x="-15" y="-12" width="30" height="24" rx="2"></rect><rect class="pw" x="-11" y="-7.5" width="5" height="5" rx="1"></rect><rect class="pw" x="-11" y="2" width="5" height="5" rx="1"></rect><path class="line2" d="M-3 -5H10M-3 4.5H8"></path><path class="nck nck1" d="M-10 -5L-8.6 -3.6L-5.5 -7.5"></path><path class="nck nck2" d="M-10 4.5L-8.6 5.9L-5.5 2"></path></g></g>

<g class="fx-bulb" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g transform="translate(50 4)"><path class="a brays ray" d="M0 -18.5V-22.5M8.1 -15.1L10.9 -17.9M-8.1 -15.1L-10.9 -17.9M11.5 -7H15.5M-11.5 -7H-15.5"></path><path class="a blb bulb" d="M-6 4C-6 0 -9 -2 -9 -7A9 9 0 0 1 9 -7C9 -2 6 0 6 4Z"></path><rect class="dk" x="-5" y="5" width="10" height="2.2" rx="1"></rect><rect class="dk" x="-4" y="8" width="8" height="2" rx="1"></rect></g></g>
